name: rigid_tank_compressor_exergy
title: Exercise: reversible work to fill a rigid air tank
summary: A rigid 200 m³ tank of air, initially at 100 kPa and 300 K, is filled by a compressor to 1 MPa at the same temperature. An exergy balance of the tank and the compressor gives the reversible work.

origin.course: Thermodynamique appliquée (ULiège, MECA0002), repetition session 10, exercise 5 (2022-2023)

verification.summary: compare_solution.py --ees-units on R10_E05_2022.EES: 23 common variables, 13 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 2; only in CoolSolve: 0. Largest printed relative difference is 9.99e-01. Lowercase kj and uppercase KJ were not scaled; after x1000, W_rev_in agrees to 6.7e-09. Air_ha h is +126061.5 J/kg. T_0 stays 300 K, so the tool's K-to-C step prints 9.10e-01.

verification.notes: The tool summary is: 23 common variables, 13 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 2; only in CoolSolve: 0. max_rel_diff is 9.99e-01, the largest relative difference the tool prints. --ees-units scaled p_0, p_1 (kPa) and X_0 (kJ), and rewrote T_0, T_1 and T_amb from K to °C.
